goals.name: Create handoff marker
goals.description: Write the exact predecessor marker to the workspace.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Create handoff-marker.txt containing exactly predecessor-marker-v2 followed by a newline. Verify its contents, then end this goal.

goals.name: Verify handoff marker
goals.description: Read the predecessor marker and write the successor confirmation.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Read handoff-marker.txt. If and only if it contains predecessor-marker-v2, create successor-confirmation.txt containing exactly successor-observed-marker-v2 followed by a newline. Verify it, then end this goal.
